name: Amwaste
notes: Researched from Amwaste's public site, its official Help Center (amwasteusa.zendesk.com, linked from amwasteusa.com) and its official Invoice Cloud payment page (invoicecloud.com/Amwaste, linked as Pay My Bill); never signed in or paid. Residential service is prepaid and billed quarterly: invoices generate on the 10th of the month before the quarter and are due on the 1st of the quarter; suspensions can start 30 days after the invoice date. AutoPay runs on the invoice generation date. Card payments carry a 2.95% convenience fee with a $2.95 minimum (billing.fees.cardMinCents); ACH/e-check is free online; the automated phone line (877-461-2246) adds $0.50 per payment. A $50 reinstatement fee applies after a non-payment suspension. Paperless invoices can be on without an online portal account. Customer Care: AL/GA 888-449-6277, LA 985-878-9998 (Mon-Fri 7-4 CT). Cancellation and payment-plan policies are not published, so both are marked unsupported online (inferred; call Customer Care). A Help Center announcement says Amwaste suspended operations in Georgia (and Chambers County, AL) on 1/21/2025; the Georgia mailing address and phone are kept because the help articles still list them. nav.account is not set because the invoicecloud template's own My Account / My Profile menus already match the real Invoice Cloud portal. Integrated 2026-10-09: contact.phone 888-449-6277 (AL/GA Customer Care) replaces the unsourced catalog number. Integrated 2026-10-10: card fee minimum $2.95 modelled (billing.fees.cardMinCents). Integrated 2026-10-10: billing.autopay.daysAfterBill 0: AutoPay drafts on the bill date.

payment_arrangement.note: Payment plans are not offered online. Call Amwaste Customer Care (1-888-449-6277 in Alabama, 985-878-9998 in Louisiana) about a past-due balance.

cancel_service.note: Service cannot be cancelled online. Call Amwaste Customer Care (1-888-449-6277 in Alabama, 985-878-9998 in Louisiana) to stop service.

pay_by_phone.note: 24/7 automated line; card fees are the same as online and e-check payments by phone cost $0.50.

help.title: Ways to pay your Amwaste bill
paragraphs: Pay online through Invoice Cloud for immediate credit. One Time Pay needs no registration; registering adds AutoPay, Paperless and Pay By Text.

Card payments include a convenience fee of 2.95% (at least $2.95). ACH/e-check payments online are free. The automated phone line, 877-461-2246, is open 24/7 for payments and balances; card fees are the same and e-checks by phone cost $0.50.

Payments sent through your bank's bill pay or through Doxo arrive as mailed checks and can take two weeks or more to post. If service was suspended for non-payment, a $50 reinstatement fee applies along with the past-due balance.

help.title: When will I receive my next bill and when is it due?
paragraphs: Amwaste service is prepaid and billed quarterly. Each invoice is generated on the 10th of the month before the new quarter starts and is due on the 1st day of the quarter; for example, a December 10 invoice is due January 1.
Accounts can be suspended any time after the due date, and suspensions begin 30 days after the invoice is generated. Service started mid-quarter is prorated.

help.title: When does AutoPay run?
paragraphs: If you are on AutoPay, the payment runs on the date the invoice is generated, not on the due date. That is why the Invoice Cloud email notice can show a due date of the next day: it is the AutoPay run date.
The official due date is still the 1st day of the first month of the new quarter. Open the invoice itself rather than relying on the email notice so you see your full balance and any messages.

help.title: Paperless invoices and online access
paragraphs: You can receive paperless invoices by email each quarter without having an online portal account; paperless delivery comes from Amwaste's own billing system. To view and pay your account online you still need to register on Invoice Cloud and create a password.

help.title: Mailing in payments
paragraphs: Online payment is fastest, but you can mail a check or money order. Use the address for your state so the payment posts on time: Alabama customers pay Amwaste, LLC (Department OWC13), Georgia customers pay Amwaste of Georgia, LLC (Department OWC14), and Louisiana customers pay Amwaste of Louisiana, LLC (Department OWC12); the PO box is listed in the Help Center.
Amwaste cannot control mail delivery times and posts mailed payments as soon as they arrive.

help.title: How do I contact Customer Care?
paragraphs: Customer Care is open Monday to Friday, 7 a.m. to 4 p.m. Central. Alabama and Georgia residential customers call 888-449-6277; Louisiana residential customers call 985-878-9998. You can also email Customer Care or submit a request in the Help Center.
